name: controlled_invalid_legacy_workers
description: Acceptance baseline digital twin: 30m × 20m × 5m assembly facility featuring an 18m manual assembly conveyor line, 8 sequential production stages, 10 operators, and finite inter-stage buffers.

stages.name: Base Assembly
stages.description: Mount caster wheels, water basin, and structural frame base.

stages.name: Motor Assembly
stages.description: Install blower fan motor, pump housing, and mounting brackets.

stages.name: Electrical Wiring
stages.description: Wire control switchboard, float valve sensor, and power harness.

stages.name: Testing
stages.description: Dielectric hi-pot test, motor current draw, and pump flow check.

stages.name: Final Assembly
stages.description: Fit honeycomb cooling pads, side louvers, and top cover.

stages.name: Quality Inspection
stages.description: Visual finish audit, airflow verification, and serial barcode tagging.

stages.name: Packing
stages.description: Protective corner foam, corrugated carton, and strapping.

stages.name: Finished Product Handling
stages.description: Palletize finished air coolers for dispatch staging.
